items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Frank Capp was the drummer and whatever. You know. So all these guys... And they’re all saying Jeez, who is this guy you know?

ctx.x: “The Gong Show,” guy, yeah. But he produced this show called “Operation Entertainment.” It was really great. And we’d go out every, for ten days every month and they did the pilot show in San Diego on an aircraft carrier. And Al was still using drugs in those days and he nodded on the show. And they had to let him go. And so Al Porcino, one of the greatest lead trumpet players of all time and certainly a big influence on me you know. But the thing about it was when they let Al go, Terry, instead of calling one of…
I love that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
